// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  about.scss — MANIFEST for the About section on the home page
//  (shadow-scoped via ?inline). Split by surface into about/ partials
//  (imported below):
//    _section        About chrome: hairline edge, profile grid, bio text
//                    columns, mentions, awards grid, glitch keyframes
//    _awards-footer  dark awards-footer band + legal links row
//  Layout: %MAXAREA column, metallic hairline top edge + filament-glow
//  background accent, draw-text paragraphs staggered left, profile card
//  right.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

@import 'about/section';
@import 'about/awards-footer';
